media_review.scope: Visual sampling of the exact public encode, not continuous subjective playback or listening.
media_review.contact_sampling: 4-second overview samples; half-second samples around victory/restart and quarter-second samples around natural defeat/restart.
observations: All public screenshots are compression-only derivatives of real game captures, with no cropping or retouching.
The native overview shows the complete arena, readable resource and ability panels, and the supporting-tower placement.
Portrait is deliberately close-framed, with visible movement and ability controls; this is emulated touch.
Victory and defeat overlays retain the matching decorative toast behind the dimmed backdrop. Actual restart visibly clears terminal UI and restores initial state.
The exact public excerpt visibly retains combat, boss, victory, natural defeat and both restarts. No private desktop chrome, path or token was visible in reviewed pixels.

privacy_review.archive_text_pattern_scan: passed except reviewed upstream license reference

reviewed_exception.reason: The unchanged upstream Debian font copyright notice cites the standard system common-licenses GPL reference. This is generic legal boilerplate, not a private user or execution path.
